properties.description_en: Work is underway on the new construction of the road on a 1.9 km section between Rjúpnavegur and Breiðholtsbraut. In addition, bridges, footpaths and underpasses will be built.

properties.description_en: Arnarnesvegur has been reopened to traffic from Breiðholtsbraut via the new bridge over Breiðholtsbraut to Vatnsendavegur. The intersection of Vatnsendavegur and Breiðholtsbraut is closed due to construction. Drivers are advised to drive to and from Vatnsendahvarfi via Vatnsendavegur, a new roundabout at Arnarnesvegur and a new intersection at Breiðholtsbraut. Road users are asked to respect the signs and show consideration
